clips.title: The story
paras: In Thelsamar, Chok'sul's Head proves the Mo'grosh chieftain is dead. Magistrate Bluntnose requires it before paying the bounty set by local dwarven authorities.

Ogres from Mo'grosh Stronghold threaten Loch Modan's settlements. They attack Thelsamar, excavation sites, and the Stonewrought Dam. Magistrate Bluntnose placed a bounty on Chok'sul, the brute believed to direct these assaults. The northeastern hills are in turmoil, so the magistrate demands clear proof before releasing township funds. Chok'sul's severed head gives the dwarven council the certainty it needs to mark the bounty fulfilled.
